summary: Chip analysis for the A100 target completed. Read chip.md in full and all 146 paths its ## Target pack declares (verified to resolve inside the project root; 25 markdown docs + 27 search.txt incl. both PDF extractions read, 2 PDFs and 94 figures verified valid and consumed through their parent documents). Recorded 41 provenance-labelled ChipFacts (F016-F056: execution_model 5, memory 6, isa 12, registers 3, toolchain 3, abi 2, runtime 4, constraints 6; 26 anchored in the declared pack, 11 RUNTIME_PROBE with commands, 4 policy/chip.md-sourced) and 6 assumptions with validation methods (A003-A008) through the engine fact/assume commands. Wrote CHIP_ANALYSIS.md covering all 8 G1 categories property-by-property, including explicit negative facts (absent Zvvm instructions, no Zvvmtls, no mixed FP16/BF16 formats, vm mask unused for matrix instructions, LMUL=1-only IME legality, the pinned QEMU BF16 IME format-control gap kept unverified, MCPM CSR not userspace-accessible, no Hypervisor in RVA23*, other-chip exclusions, unusable SpacemiT LLVM), the knowledge-profile declaration (present: k3-a100), and three reported (not averaged) documentation framing differences (IME lambda figure-caption vs tables; X100 L2 brief vs manual; Preview vs production A100 cluster composition) - none affecting codegen. Correctness_only: no performance anchors, timings or speedups recorded (the 60 TOPS INT4-sparse headline is recorded only as a qualified specification, explicitly not a target). CHIP_ANALYSIS.md exists at the task's declared output path docs/compiler-agent/CHIP_ANALYSIS.md and as an identical copy at the project root, which is where the engine's G1 check reads it (WORKFLOW_ROOT_ARTIFACTS convention).

remaining_work: The workload-analysis phase (G2) consumes these chip facts next; the corpus dtype surface fact F037 and the IME family constraints (F030-F034) are its direct inputs

Board-porting validation items A003-A008 (integer/alignment probes, cross-hart memory model, TCM/DMA/spinlock interfaces, matrix-engine pairing) remain open by design and must not be silently defaulted by later phases

The BF16 IME format-control gap (F034) stays unverified: BF16 dot cases must run via the ordinary vector path under the pinned emulator until a passing BF16 probe exists, and no BF16 IME execution claim may be made from FP16 or vector success
